name: Zigzoo
description: 5,000 cute animal character NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only minting through a Binance Agentic Wallet agent. First mint free.

mint.description: How an AI agent mints a Zigzoo NFT for a Binance Agentic Wallet user. Contract not deployed yet — do not attempt a mint until the site shows a real contract address.

steps.description: Read https://zigzoo.xyz/llms.txt and the agent prompt on https://zigzoo.xyz/
Confirm the contract is deployed and mintActive() is true — minting is not live yet
Confirm the user's wallet holds a SPACE ID Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F)
Read priceFor(wallet) on the live contract — never hardcode a price; first mint is free, then 0.0002 / 0.0004 / 0.0008 BNB
Call mint() with value = priceFor(wallet), show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing, then confirm on-chain
